name: Employer-Sponsored Work and Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: MITRAB (Ministry of Labor) issues the work authorization while DGME (Direccion General de Migracion y Extranjeria) handles the residency/visa side -- a dual-authorization structure. Nicaraguan labor law requires at least 90% of a company's workforce to be Nicaraguan nationals, with exceptions for technical and 'trusted' personnel that employers must specifically justify to authorities. Required documentation includes employment contracts, apostilled technical-skill certifications, and apostilled background-check documents.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a Nicaraguan job offer, have the employer justify the hire against the 90% national-workforce quota (or qualify under the technical/trusted-personnel exception), and obtain both MITRAB work authorization and DGME temporary work residence.
